native_result.query: What kind of demographic disparities exist in median wealth in 1985 among individuals who were ever incarcerated?
native_result.HypoA: Gender disparities exist in median wealth in 1985 among individuals who were ever incarcerated, with males having higher median wealth than females.
native_result.HypoB: Among NLSY79 respondents who were ever incarcerated (ever_jailed==1, n=289; jailed at some point 1985–1994), median 1985 wealth was extremely low overall (median $720; 45% at zero or negative net worth) and sharply stratified demographically. Racial hierarchy: white median $2,200 ≈ 7× the black median $320, while the hispanic median was $0 (white–hispanic gap effectively unbounded in ratio terms; 50% of hispanic ever-incarcerated at ≤$0). Gender gap: incarcerated men median $1,000 vs women $0 (70% of women vs 40% of men at ≤$0). Race×sex: white men $2,000 and white women $4,100 (n=12) at the top; black men $800 (0.40× white male) and hispanic men $700 (0.35×) in the middle; black and hispanic women at $0 (80–90% at ≤$0) at the bottom. Means greatly exceed medians in every group (e.g., white men mean $14,308 vs median $2,000), confirming right skew from a few high-wealth outliers. Context: the same race/sex gradient exists among the never-jailed at higher levels (white male $5,500; black male $1,500), so ever-incarcerated respondents were wealth-poor across all groups, with a black–white relative gap of similar magnitude inside and outside the incarcerated subsample. Timing caveat: the jailing flag spans 1985–1994 while wealth is 1985, so 1985 wealth may predate, coincide with, or postdate first jailing; this characterizes the eventually-incarcerated population's 1985 wealth, not a causal pre/post effect.
native_result.WorkflowB: Loaded nls_incarceration_processed.csv (12,013×6, zero missingness); verified composite_wealth_1985 negatives/zeros as valid net wealth (range −$57,587 to $2,574,706) and retained them without trimming or imputation; filtered to ever_jailed==1 (n=289); relabeled data typo 'hipanic'→'hispanic'; computed median, mean, p25/p75, and share ≤0 of composite_wealth_1985 by race, sex, and race×sex; expressed disparities vs white males as absolute differences and ratios; computed ever_jailed==0 (n=11,724) statistics as secondary context; documented right skew via mean-vs-median contrast and flagged small female cells (n=9–16). Executed script: analysis.py; full output: output/analysis_output.txt.
